item.title: Hamas terms Nasser Medical Complex bombardment as full-fledged war crime
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Resistance Movement of Palestine (Hamas), condemning the bombing of the “Nasser Medical Complex” in Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip, which resulted in the martyrdom of six Palestinian citizens and the injury of 20 others, held the Zionist regime and the Board of Peace responsible for this crime.

item.title: Iran’s missile development will not be halted by threats or sanctions: IRGC chief
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Major General Ahmad Vahidi says Iran’s efforts to strengthen its military capabilities will continue despite threats and sanctions, stressing that the path pioneered by the late missile commander Hassan Tehrani Moghaddam cannot be stopped.

item.title: Baqaei condoles with families of those who lost their lives in the factory explosion in Türkiye
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baqaei, in a message while referring to an explosion at an iron and steel manufacturing plant in the province of Izmir, western Turkiye, extended condolences and sympathy of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the families of the victims, as well as to the government and people of the friendly neighboring country.
